note: Re-judged 2026-11-10 by an independent judge after a comment-only change to TestPortEncodingFollowsSection3131 (assertions, fixtures and producers byte-identical). Same finding as RFC7296-3.13.1-1 for End Port: the test proves ANY -> 65535 under protocol 0, with TCP 443/443 as the discriminator, but cannot fail on a port-undefined protocol other than 0. Ze emits a specific End Port there, because checkPortProgrammable and programmableSelector only treat protocol 0 as portless, while RFC 7296 Section 3.13.1 says the field MUST be 65535.
